items.title: Silicon Valley Is Completely Divided Over Chinese AI

items.title: World Foundation Raises $52.5M to Scale Sam Altman’s ‘Proof of Human’ ID
items.summary: Pantera Capital led the one-year locked token sale, joined by Bain Capital Crypto, as World scales its ID network for AI agents.

items.title: WPP’s sweeping restructure could save £500 million—the bigger challenge might be winning over workers
items.summary: The advertising giant is simplifying its structure as it aims to arrest its decline. Chief people officer Marie-Claire Barker says the harder task is rebuilding trust, changing leadership behavior, and creating a unified culture across its 90,000 employees.
items.titleZh: WPP的全面重组可以节省5亿英镑——更大的挑战可能是赢得工人
items.summaryZh: 这家广告巨头正在简化其结构，以遏制其衰落。首席人事官Marie-Claire Barker表示，更艰巨的任务是重建信任，改变领导行为，并在其9万名员工中建立统一的文化。

items.title: Microsoft is testing free Xbox cloud gaming with ads, no subscription required
items.summary: For a limited time, Xbox Insiders can now access games they own over the cloud on Xbox consoles, PCs, and mobile devices without subscribing to Game Pass. Microsoft promises that the ads will be unobtrusive.Read Entire Article

items.summaryZh: 在有限的时间内，Xbox Insider现在可以在Xbox游戏机、PC和移动设备上通过云访问他们拥有的游戏，而无需订阅Game Pass。微软承诺这些广告不会引人注目。阅读整篇文章

items.titleZh: NHTSA驳回特斯拉车门释放缺陷申请，开启新车门规则
items.summaryZh: 美国国家公路交通安全管理局拒绝了一份请愿书，该请愿书要求对特斯拉Model 3上隐藏的手动车门释放装置进行缺陷调查。但在同一决定中，该机构同意开始为整个汽车行业制定新的车门安全规则。

items.title: Trump promises cheaper power from data centers. Analysts say bills could jump 40%
